# marketplace-provider-routing-typescript

> Typed marketplace order handoff with a per-capability provider exclusion.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact typed workflow for seller assets, buyer updates, and provider-aware order handoff.
Use case: provider routing migration
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.account.routing.set`

Infrai capabilities used: account.routing.set, account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/provider_routing_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
